title: Localized pure-tensor degreewise currying equation
statement: For a ringed site and cochain complexes K,L,M of sheaf modules, define the degreewise curry equation on a morphism a from homComplex K (homComplex L M) in degree n to homComplex Tot(K tensor L) M in degree n by requiring that on every localized site and every pair of pure-tensor inputs x in K^p and y in L^q, the (p+q)-projection of a(s) evaluated on the total-tensor inclusion of x tensor y equals the q-projection of the p-projection of s evaluated first on x and then on y. The projections are those selected with homComplex_exists and the map from the presheaf tensor is the sheafification unit followed by the tensor comparison inverse. This extracts verbatim the existing HomTensorCurryCondition construction, with its two auxiliary maps, into a module that contains no existence theorem.

lean.statement:
def HomTensorDegreewiseEquation (K L M : CochainComplex Mod ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    ((homComplex (R := R) K (homComplex (R := R) L M)).X n ⟶
      (homComplex (R := R)
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)) M).X n) → Prop
